BackstoryDef.title: Saarthal child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up within sight of the city's old walls, in a family who insisted the Nords would be gone by spring.

BackstoryDef.title: wayshrine child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_possessive] parents kept a wayshrine on the pilgrim road, so [PAWN_nameDef] grew up offering water to strangers and memorizing where the crevasses were.

BackstoryDef.title: choir novice
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] sang the morning hour for six years at the Chantry, on an empty stomach, in a hall with no fire in it.

BackstoryDef.title: glacier climber
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s family kept goats on the edge of the ice, and the children were sent after the ones who wandered. Most came back.

BackstoryDef.title: stonecutter's child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] learned on the white quarries that a block that cracks is a year wasted. Nobody needed to raise their voice to make the point.

BackstoryDef.title: prince's ward
BackstoryDef.description: After a border skirmish left [PAWN_objective] orphaned, [PAWN_nameDef] was raised at a lesser court, educated carefully and reminded often of what that had cost.

BackstoryDef.title: Night of Tears orphan
BackstoryDef.description: The Night of Tears took everything from [PAWN_nameDef], though who started it was never explained to [PAWN_objective] in the same way twice.

BackstoryDef.title: hymn copyist
BackstoryDef.description: Each hymn had to be copied without a single error, and an error meant starting over. [PAWN_nameDef] has very neat handwriting and a wary expression.

BackstoryDef.title: Vale guardsman
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] walked the Forgotten Vale's frozen paths with a spear, driving off what the snow hid. Each winter there were fewer to share the watch.

BackstoryDef.title: ice-field archer
BackstoryDef.description: On a white plain under a white sky, [PAWN_nameDef] learned to judge distance by the shadow of the arrow itself.

BackstoryDef.title: Chantry paladin
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] swore to keep the doors of the Chantry, and has kept them through more sieges than [PAWN_pronoun] cares to list.

BackstoryDef.title: Moesring veteran
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] stood with the Snow Prince in the last field battle on Solstheim, and saw a child's arrow end it. There is no comfortable way to tell that story.

BackstoryDef.title: Five Hundred's foe
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] fought Ysgramor's Companions through three failed sieges. [PAWN_pronoun] will grudgingly concede they were not bad at this.

BackstoryDef.title: pass sentry
BackstoryDef.description: Alone in a stone hut above a mountain pass, [PAWN_nameDef] watched for smoke for twenty winters and lit the beacon exactly twice.

BackstoryDef.title: shrine curate
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] kept the hours at a minor shrine with no congregation left, on the theory that Auri-El might still be listening.

BackstoryDef.title: priest of the Aetherial Light
BackstoryDef.description: The sun's power can be drawn through a focus and thrown, and [PAWN_nameDef] has done so in anger. [PAWN_pronoun] still does penance for one of those times.

BackstoryDef.title: keeper of relics
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] looked after the Chantry's reliquary, including a few things that should not be handled, and knows which is which.

BackstoryDef.title: Eye of Magnus scholar
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] read every account of what lay buried at Saarthal, and came to believe the Falmer wanted it badly enough to start a war.

BackstoryDef.title: frost healer
BackstoryDef.description: Cold slows a wound and a skilled hand can use that. [PAWN_nameDef] saved many a soldier on the ice, and has kept a few of their fingers.

BackstoryDef.title: white-stone mason
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] raised vaults with no mortar and no iron. Ice has broken mountains in the north, and those vaults are still there.

BackstoryDef.title: ice road trader
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] ran sledges between the northern cities, selling salt and furs. The Dwemer were always excellent customers until they were not.

BackstoryDef.title: highland herder
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] kept shaggy goats on the ice margins, and learned that animals sense an avalanche long before anyone else does.

BackstoryDef.title: envoy to the Dwemer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] went under the mountain to ask for shelter. The Dwemer were entirely courteous. That has troubled [PAWN_objective] every day since.

BackstoryDef.title: chantry cook
BackstoryDef.description: Fasting is half the Chantry's calendar. On the other half, [PAWN_nameDef] feeds everyone, with whatever the ice lets through.

BackstoryDef.title: vestment weaver
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] wove the white robes of the priesthood. The pattern hadn't changed in a thousand years, and [PAWN_pronoun] would like to speak to anyone who suggests it should.

BackstoryDef.title: escaped thrall
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] went below with the rest and saw what the Dwemer's fungus did to those who ate it. [PAWN_pronoun] walked out through three miles of machinery and has not stopped being angry.

BackstoryDef.title: Moesring shepherd's child
BackstoryDef.description: Goats on Moesring Pass did not recognize borders. Neither did [PAWN_nameDef], who followed them halfway to the Nord camps and was carried back by the ear.

BackstoryDef.title: Forgotten Vale child
BackstoryDef.description: Snow fell on the Vale in great soft sheets, and the old ones said the light there was a gift. [PAWN_nameDef] thought everyone's valley glowed.

BackstoryDef.title: hymn runner
BackstoryDef.description: Hymns for the Chantries were sent from Vale to coast in the mouths of children, because parchment could freeze. [PAWN_nameDef] forgot only one verse in eight years.

BackstoryDef.title: ice cave explorer
BackstoryDef.description: Glacier caves are blue inside, with a sound like breathing. [PAWN_nameDef] went deeper than anyone had said to, and came back with frostbitten toes and no regrets.

BackstoryDef.title: prince's stable child
BackstoryDef.description: Horses came with the Snow Prince's household from a warmer land and never quite got over it. [PAWN_nameDef] rubbed down their legs and told them things would improve.

BackstoryDef.title: Dimhollow candle child
BackstoryDef.description: Deep in the crypt, a very long-burning candle stood beside each of the dead. [PAWN_nameDef] walked the rows at dusk, replacing whichever ones had gone out.

BackstoryDef.title: coast fisher's child
BackstoryDef.description: Seal and white fish came ashore along the Sea of Ghosts, along with driftwood and news. [PAWN_nameDef] saw Atmoran ships on the horizon before anyone believed the stories.

BackstoryDef.title: glacier herb gatherer
BackstoryDef.description: Few things bloom above the tree line, and those that do are precious. [PAWN_nameDef] climbed for them in summer and sold the best to the chantry healers.

BackstoryDef.title: Saarthal market child
BackstoryDef.description: Saarthal's market sold rare things from the south, and also lied a lot. [PAWN_nameDef] ran between the stalls, carrying change and collecting the better lies.

BackstoryDef.title: Chantry bell child
BackstoryDef.description: The sun rises late in winter, and the bell tells the valley when. [PAWN_nameDef] rang it each morning at Auri-El's Chantry and came to know exactly how cold bronze could get.

BackstoryDef.title: Dwemer trade guest
BackstoryDef.description: Dwemer merchants sometimes brought a child along to the Vale, and sometimes took one home. [PAWN_nameDef] spent a winter in a Dwemer hold and came back with a lot of questions.

BackstoryDef.title: snow-gardener's child
BackstoryDef.description: Roses of a kind grow under glass near the hot springs. [PAWN_nameDef] brushed the snow off the panes every morning and was allowed to take home the wilted ones.

BackstoryDef.title: mountain messenger
BackstoryDef.description: Passes close quickly in the far north. [PAWN_nameDef] went on foot and on skis between towns while the road was still open, and knew when to stay put.

BackstoryDef.title: wolfskin tanner's child
BackstoryDef.description: White wolf pelts sold well as far as Alinor. [PAWN_nameDef] scraped them in a cold shed and wore the rejects, which is how the child got the nickname.

BackstoryDef.title: ice-sculpture helper
BackstoryDef.description: Each winter, the Vale filled up with ice carved by masters, gone again by spring. [PAWN_nameDef] carried water and chisels, and thought it a great waste until adulthood.

BackstoryDef.title: Ysgramor's return orphan
BackstoryDef.description: The Five Hundred came ashore looking for blood. [PAWN_nameDef] came out of the wreck of a village with a few burned books and very little else.

BackstoryDef.title: lyre pupil
BackstoryDef.description: Lessons were held in a cold room, because warm fingers are easily spoiled. [PAWN_nameDef] played for the priests and was only sometimes told to stop.

BackstoryDef.title: Night of Tears witness
BackstoryDef.description: Snow-Elf children are told how Saarthal's hall burned. [PAWN_nameDef] needs no telling, having seen the smoke rise from the far side of a frozen bay.

BackstoryDef.title: Aetherial light watcher
BackstoryDef.description: Priests of Auri-El believed the first light of morning told you things. A young [PAWN_nameDef] sat on the roof to watch it and wrote everything down in charcoal.

BackstoryDef.title: ski maker's child
BackstoryDef.description: Bent birch and a good waxing would take you most places in the north. [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a shed full of steaming wood and tested each pair on the steepest slope.

BackstoryDef.title: Falkreath border child
BackstoryDef.description: South of the snow line, the land goes green and the woods fill with game. [PAWN_nameDef] grew up on that edge, unsure about the shoes.

BackstoryDef.title: Chantry orphan
BackstoryDef.description: The priests took in whoever came through the door, and in those years there were many. [PAWN_nameDef] was raised on thin soup and long sermons, and turned out all right.

BackstoryDef.title: knight's page
BackstoryDef.description: Cleaning armor is a skill, and it pays to take the mail apart with care. [PAWN_nameDef] served a Knight-Paladin and got to hold the good sword on one memorable day.

BackstoryDef.title: ivory carver's child
BackstoryDef.description: Mammoth tusk came down from the giants in trade. [PAWN_nameDef] started by carving spoons, then moved on to tiny saints with very cross faces.

BackstoryDef.title: snowbound scholar
BackstoryDef.description: An avalanche sealed the road to the family's house for one whole winter. [PAWN_nameDef] read the entire library and came out, thin and pale, with many opinions.

BackstoryDef.title: sled-dog child
BackstoryDef.description: Hauling freight through the passes takes strong dogs and stubborn drivers. [PAWN_nameDef] slept among the team and learned their language, which was mostly complaints.

BackstoryDef.title: Sea of Ghosts wreck-picker
BackstoryDef.description: Ice grinds up what comes close to that coast. [PAWN_nameDef] walked out over the floes after each storm to see what might be pulled from the wrecks.

BackstoryDef.title: temple scribe's child
BackstoryDef.description: Copying the Canticles of the Aetherial was slow, and ink needed thawing near the fire. [PAWN_nameDef] sat by the coals and kept it liquid until [PAWN_pronoun] could write too.

BackstoryDef.title: Winterhold shore child
BackstoryDef.description: Before anyone had thought of a College there, the cliffs were just a good place to gather gull eggs. [PAWN_nameDef] went down the ropes each spring.

BackstoryDef.title: skater
BackstoryDef.description: Lakes in the Vale freeze clear as window glass. [PAWN_nameDef] could go across one faster than a horse and proved it, with costly consequences.

BackstoryDef.title: mine-town child
BackstoryDef.description: Silver from the Reach-side mines kept the Snow Prince's court in fine dishes. [PAWN_nameDef] grew up among those who dug it, who ate off wood.

BackstoryDef.title: physician's pupil
BackstoryDef.description: Frostbite was the first thing [PAWN_nameDef] learned to treat and the last one that was fully understood. There's a strict order for what you try to save.

BackstoryDef.title: highborn hostage
BackstoryDef.description: Treaties with the Dwemer sometimes came with a guest from a good family. [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a stone hall far underground and was treated with courtesy.

BackstoryDef.title: snow-bear cub's friend
BackstoryDef.description: Someone found an orphaned bear, and [PAWN_nameDef] was blamed for feeding it. By spring it weighed more than the child, and the parting was difficult for all.

BackstoryDef.title: lantern festival child
BackstoryDef.description: On the longest night, each house in the Vale hung its lights on the pines. [PAWN_nameDef] made the lanterns, and remembers that festival with particular longing.

BackstoryDef.title: road-marker painter
BackstoryDef.description: Waystones vanish under drifts unless they're painted red. [PAWN_nameDef] went along the road each autumn with a bucket and a bad-tempered mule.

BackstoryDef.title: Snow Prince's admirer
BackstoryDef.description: Stories of the Snow Prince's last stand were all the children wanted to play at. [PAWN_nameDef] always played the prince and, unusually, refused to die at the end.

BackstoryDef.title: thrall-camp survivor
BackstoryDef.description: Some of those who ran to the Dwemer didn't remain free for long. [PAWN_nameDef] got out in the very early days of it and doesn't speak of the tunnels.

BackstoryDef.title: cold-kitchen child
BackstoryDef.description: Stews took all day in a mountain kitchen, and somebody had to mind the fire. [PAWN_nameDef] was that somebody and acquired an impressive knowledge of barley.

BackstoryDef.title: bird-netter
BackstoryDef.description: White ptarmigan feed on the slopes and don't look up. [PAWN_nameDef] strung nets over a gully and took home enough to be useful.

BackstoryDef.title: choir child with a cough
BackstoryDef.description: A winter sickness damaged [PAWN_nameDef]'s voice, ending all prospects in the choir. Theory of music turned out to be an acceptable consolation.

BackstoryDef.title: Vyrthur's acolyte
BackstoryDef.description: Acolytes of the Chantry served the priests in shifts. [PAWN_nameDef] brought Vyrthur's breakfast for a season, and later had reason to remember how he looked at the Vale.

BackstoryDef.title: Knight-Paladin
BackstoryDef.description: Gelebor and his brother were not the only ones who wore the white and gold. [PAWN_nameDef] took the same oath, kept vigil in the same snow and is still on duty.

BackstoryDef.title: Moesring rearguard
BackstoryDef.description: Everyone knows who died at Moesring Pass. Fewer people have heard of those who held the back of the column long enough so that anyone could get away, including [PAWN_nameDef].

BackstoryDef.title: bridge warden
BackstoryDef.description: Bridges in the Vale are old, narrow and very useful to hold. [PAWN_nameDef] stood on one for six years and watched it rebuilt twice beneath [PAWN_possessive] boots.

BackstoryDef.title: Atmoran-hunter
BackstoryDef.description: Nords in small groups came up the valleys for loot. [PAWN_nameDef] picked them out at distance and left the survivors something to report at home.

BackstoryDef.title: snowfield skirmisher
BackstoryDef.description: White cloaks and a bow are about all you need on the open snow. [PAWN_nameDef] ran with a band that struck supply sleds and vanished before the alarm went up.

BackstoryDef.title: Dwemer-garrison liaison
BackstoryDef.description: Dwemer offered shelter to the refugees and then sent somebody to measure them. [PAWN_nameDef] was among the first to see what was coming, and the first to be ignored.

BackstoryDef.title: vigilant of the crypts
BackstoryDef.description: The dead of the Prince's house are guarded even now. [PAWN_nameDef] walked the Vale's lower chambers with a blade, and had reason to use it on things that walked.

BackstoryDef.title: Falmer-hunter
BackstoryDef.description: Betrayed kin came up from below, blind and starving, and they had to be fought. [PAWN_nameDef] goes after them knowing full well what they were, and doesn't discuss it.

BackstoryDef.title: Saarthal gate guard
BackstoryDef.description: Gates were open on the night the Atmorans were massacred, and it's been argued ever since who ordered what. [PAWN_nameDef] was on duty and has never given a straight answer.

BackstoryDef.title: avalanche sapper
BackstoryDef.description: With the right arrow in the right spot, a whole slope can come down on an enemy. [PAWN_nameDef] studied the snow for years and could call it down with a word.

BackstoryDef.title: Vale archer captain
BackstoryDef.description: Frozen fingers don't draw well. [PAWN_nameDef] drilled that into every recruit, along with a firm rule on gloves and fair warning about what would happen without them.

BackstoryDef.title: sled raider
BackstoryDef.description: Dog teams move faster than an army on a good crust. [PAWN_nameDef]'s band went down on Nord camps at dawn, and left long before the shouting stopped.

BackstoryDef.title: ice-field tracker
BackstoryDef.description: Marks on the snow last until the next wind. [PAWN_nameDef] could read them by moonlight and tell you what kind of Nord made them and how hungry he was.

BackstoryDef.title: pass guardian
BackstoryDef.description: A small stone hut on the highest pass was home for most of [PAWN_nameDef]'s career. Very few travelers passed by, and even fewer of them were friendly.

BackstoryDef.title: Prince's sworn sword
BackstoryDef.description: An oath to the Snow Prince did not end when he fell. [PAWN_nameDef] goes on keeping it, in a world that has mostly forgotten what he stood for.

BackstoryDef.title: Ysgramor's prisoner
BackstoryDef.description: The Companions took a few alive, for reasons they kept to themselves. [PAWN_nameDef] broke out after one winter, and took along a good Atmoran axe.

BackstoryDef.title: wolf-rider of the north
BackstoryDef.description: Great white wolves will carry a light rider, if raised to it. [PAWN_nameDef] raised three, and they all still come when whistled for.

BackstoryDef.title: Chantry priest
BackstoryDef.description: Auri-El's chantries follow a very strict calendar. [PAWN_nameDef] kept it through a war and a famine and could tell you which saint had been skipped.

BackstoryDef.title: sunlight weaver
BackstoryDef.description: Sunlight can be gathered and then released, with a little effort and a long education. [PAWN_nameDef] has done it often enough to burn the eyes out of a charging Nord.

BackstoryDef.title: Aetherial scholar
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] studied what the Aetherial Plane might be and whether it was home. The research was mostly unfinished when Saarthal fell.

BackstoryDef.title: keeper of the Bow
BackstoryDef.description: Auri-El's Bow was supposed to be a thing you protected. [PAWN_nameDef] served the shrine where it was held and has opinions about how it was used.

BackstoryDef.title: wayshrine keeper
BackstoryDef.description: Five wayshrines mark out the path of initiation and all need tending. [PAWN_nameDef] walked between them, clearing snow, relighting braziers and blessing tired pilgrims.

BackstoryDef.title: initiate-tester
BackstoryDef.description: No one gets to the Chantry without passing a trial of the pilgrim's route. [PAWN_nameDef] watched them come and turned away most, without apology.

BackstoryDef.title: frost mage of Saarthal
BackstoryDef.description: Saarthal's scholars used frost the way others use pen and ink. [PAWN_nameDef] learned its many varieties and got rather fond of the sharp ones.

BackstoryDef.title: relic forger
BackstoryDef.description: An eager pilgrim doesn't look at a saint's knucklebone too closely. [PAWN_nameDef] supplied a few chantries with honest forgeries, and paid for it in the next life.

BackstoryDef.title: physician of the Vale
BackstoryDef.description: Snow blindness, frostbite and old war wounds came in by the sledload. [PAWN_nameDef] worked with hot water and the Light and saved perhaps one patient more than average.

BackstoryDef.title: astronomer of the north
BackstoryDef.description: Nights are long up there and the sky very clear. [PAWN_nameDef] charted the stars from a tower of ice and rebuilt the tower every spring.

BackstoryDef.title: Eye-seeker
BackstoryDef.description: What Ysgramor's people dug up at Saarthal was bigger than anyone thought. [PAWN_nameDef] spent a lifetime tracing the old reports of what the Falmer truly had in that hall.

BackstoryDef.title: canticle scribe
BackstoryDef.description: Scripture needs copying before it's lost, and a lot had already been lost. [PAWN_nameDef] wrote out what survivors could remember, with notes on where they disagreed.

BackstoryDef.title: chantry exorcist
BackstoryDef.description: Vampires come to a place like the Vale for the long night and the isolation. [PAWN_nameDef] came for them, with a mace blessed by a very stern priest.

BackstoryDef.title: mind-healer
BackstoryDef.description: Many survivors of the Dwemer tunnels have trouble sleeping. [PAWN_nameDef] sits with them through the night and does not ask them to explain.

BackstoryDef.title: ice-glass enchanter
BackstoryDef.description: Some Snow Elf works were made of a clear stuff that doesn't melt in a warm room. [PAWN_nameDef] knows how it's made, and is one of the last who does.

BackstoryDef.title: Vale's voice
BackstoryDef.description: Songs in the old high tongue carry from one end of the Vale to the other. [PAWN_nameDef] led the singing when there were many left to sing it.

BackstoryDef.title: sun-fast ascetic
BackstoryDef.description: By long tradition, some of the devout took only what they could gather in full daylight. In the far north, [PAWN_nameDef] found that this is a much harder winter than most.

BackstoryDef.title: dawn-speaker
BackstoryDef.description: Every chantry had someone who announced the dawn, whatever else was going on. [PAWN_nameDef] called it in the middle of a siege, and it arrived on time.

BackstoryDef.title: Vyrthur's dissenter
BackstoryDef.description: The old arch-curate started to speak strangely long before the end. [PAWN_nameDef] said so at a council and was reassigned to a very distant shrine.

BackstoryDef.title: snow farmer
BackstoryDef.description: Hot springs make small warm plots out of frozen valleys. [PAWN_nameDef] got good barley out of one, with terraces and a lot of cursing under the breath.

BackstoryDef.title: whale-oil merchant
BackstoryDef.description: Whales lit the lamps of half of Skyrim before the wars. [PAWN_nameDef] traded the oil up and down the coast and came to dislike the smell only much later.

BackstoryDef.title: ice-cutter of the lake
BackstoryDef.description: Clean ice sold to the south at very silly prices. [PAWN_nameDef] cut it with a long saw, packed it in straw and took the profit in dried fruit.

BackstoryDef.title: sled-road keeper
BackstoryDef.description: Sled roads need smoothing and packing after every storm. [PAWN_nameDef] kept up one stretch of road for thirty years and knew each drift personally.

BackstoryDef.title: furrier of Saarthal
BackstoryDef.description: White fox trim sold very well to those who wanted to look northern. [PAWN_nameDef] dressed half the visitors in Saarthal, along with a few of its enemies.

BackstoryDef.title: inn-keeper of the pass
BackstoryDef.description: Nobody goes by the highest inn on the road without stopping, because it's that or freeze. [PAWN_nameDef] charged accordingly and served a hot broth that was widely mentioned.

BackstoryDef.title: ivory merchant
BackstoryDef.description: Mammoth ivory comes from giants, who are hard to bargain with. [PAWN_nameDef] managed it with a lot of salt, a lot of patience and one close escape.

BackstoryDef.title: silver miner
BackstoryDef.description: Silver from the Vale's mines paid for the Chantries' candlesticks. [PAWN_nameDef] went in at dawn, came out after dark, and only saw the sun on holy days.

BackstoryDef.title: goat cheese maker
BackstoryDef.description: A hard white cheese could keep through a whole Skyrim winter. [PAWN_nameDef]'s was known as far as Solitude and could, when well aged, be used as a doorstop.

BackstoryDef.title: glass-house keeper
BackstoryDef.description: Fruit trees grew behind glass in the houses of the rich. [PAWN_nameDef] kept one alive through nine winters, and was very upset with the tenth.

BackstoryDef.title: winter storyteller
BackstoryDef.description: Long nights empty the house of everything but the fire and whoever's talking. [PAWN_nameDef] went from village to village and got paid in food and a warm bed.

BackstoryDef.title: bone-and-horn comb maker
BackstoryDef.description: White hair needs care, and the people of the Vale were vain about theirs. [PAWN_nameDef] made combs for them all and heard most of their secrets.

BackstoryDef.title: snow-sheep shearer
BackstoryDef.description: Mountain sheep grow a long, tough fleece and resent losing it. [PAWN_nameDef] sheared the flock each spring and got kicked in a variety of places.

BackstoryDef.title: old-war refugee
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] walked from one burned town to the next with whoever was left. In time that became a kind of trade, with its own routines and know-how.

BackstoryDef.title: tomb carver
BackstoryDef.description: There were many dead after Saarthal, and each one deserved a name in stone. [PAWN_nameDef] went on cutting them for decades, with no shortage of work.

BackstoryDef.title: snowshoe maker
BackstoryDef.description: Bent ash and gut lacing will carry someone across a very deep drift. [PAWN_nameDef] made them by the hundred, as there were never enough to go around.

BackstoryDef.title: hot-spring bath keeper
BackstoryDef.description: Everyone in the Vale eventually comes to the springs, including those who aren't speaking to each other. [PAWN_nameDef] seated them accordingly and kept the peace.

BackstoryDef.title: mule driver
BackstoryDef.description: Mules can walk the passes when everything else stays home. [PAWN_nameDef] walked behind them for a good many years, on the same terms.

BackstoryDef.title: chantry baker
BackstoryDef.description: Holy bread rises slowly in the cold. [PAWN_nameDef] got up at the third bell each night, and had the loaves ready by the time the priests came in.

BackstoryDef.title: Atmoran interpreter
BackstoryDef.description: Somebody at Saarthal could speak to the Atmorans and be understood. [PAWN_nameDef] was one of them, and was never quite trusted again by either side.

BackstoryDef.title: road-toll clerk
BackstoryDef.description: Traders on the Vale road paid a toll at a small hut, in coin or kind. [PAWN_nameDef] wrote it all in a neat hand and kept a separate list of who had lied.

BackstoryDef.title: net weaver
BackstoryDef.description: Winter fishing goes on through holes in the ice, and a net needs to fit the hole. [PAWN_nameDef] made them for most of the lake's villages and kept the best for [PAWN_objective]self.

BackstoryDef.title: escaped Dwemer servant
BackstoryDef.description: Not every Falmer below became a thrall at once. [PAWN_nameDef] spent years as a household servant in a Dwemer hold, and saw the change coming in the food.
